verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://trilegal.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured header describing the firm, and the file directs agents to use index pages to discover detailed subpages, so an agent can be pointed at it. Missing for 10: evidence of how deep or complete the llms.txt coverage is (e.g., an llms-full.txt or per-practice markdown), other agent-oriented docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.
